verdict.rationale: The evidence pack includes a first-party 'Monitors' documentation page, which points to a native alerting capability. However, the pack contains only the page title, with no content showing that alerts can target any telemetry signal or that routing, grouping, or silencing exist. Missing for 10: evidence of alerting across all signal types (metrics, logs, traces, etc.), notification routing, alert grouping, silencing/downtime capability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can alert on any telemetry signal with routing, grouping, and silencing of notifications
